final: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(`ANA Pattern`),''),'(none)') AS p, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS a FROM Examination GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(`ANA Pattern`),''),'(none)')), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS ma FROM g WHERE a IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT g.p AS p, g.a AS a, g.a - m.ma AS above_mean FROM g, m WHERE g.a > m.ma) SELECT p AS ana_pattern, a AS avg_acl_igg, above_mean, a - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k ORDER BY a DESC
